caption: The drawing contains four textile objects arranged on a neutral background. In the upper left, there is a small, rectangular wrist warmer that is light purple in color and features a textured, bobbled surface. To its right, there is a long black sock or stocking with a cuff that has red and gray horizontal stripes and a scalloped upper edge, with a single red thread extending upward from the top. Below the wrist warmer, there is a mitten with alternating vertical stripes of green and pinkish-red; the cuff of the mitten includes a decorative band with green and pink chevrons, as well as additional green and pink horizontal stripes. To the right of the mitten, overlapping with the lower part of the striped sock, is another sock or stocking that is entirely dark blue or black, with visible ribbing and reinforced areas at the heel and toe. The name "Fritz Boehmer" appears in small text at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Zoar Beaded Wristlet, Mitten and Sock
